profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record, tagged Verizon Freehold Data Center, sits near Interlaken Court in Freehold Township, Monmouth County, New Jersey. Unlike several other records in this Verizon cluster, New Jersey falls squarely within Verizon nine-state incumbent local exchange carrier footprint, the territory Verizon inherited through the Bell Atlantic and NYNEX mergers that formed the modern Verizon in 2000, so a legacy central-office or regional network facility explanation is at least geographically plausible here even though it is not independently confirmed. The telecom=data_center tag was added in August 2026 by a single OpenStreetMap contributor who identified themselves as an engineer and cited local knowledge as the source, as part of a larger batch of roughly seventy two changes made in one editing session. Local knowledge from a single, unverifiable contributor is a weaker form of sourcing than a business filing, operator press release, or property record, and this research did not find any independent corroborating source, such as a nearby communications tower, a county property record, or a Verizon-published facility list, that names this specific address as an active data center. Monmouth County has historically hosted Bell System and later Verizon central-office and network infrastructure consistent with the dense suburban telephone plant built out across central New Jersey in the twentieth century, which makes a legacy network facility a reasonable inference, but readers should understand that inference as unconfirmed rather than sourced. No capacity, technical square footage, tier rating, or year-built figures are asserted here because no source establishes them, and the facility function, whether a switching center, network operations site, or something else, remains undocumented beyond the OSM tag itself.
